strings.name: Raghuram Rajan
strings.role: Economist · Former Reserve Bank of India governor
strings.summary: Rajan studied electrical engineering and management before researching banking at MIT and teaching long-term at Chicago. A former IMF chief economist, he discussed risks from financial innovation in 2005 and governed the Reserve Bank of India from 2013 to 2016. His research covers banking, institutions and development; his books address financial crises and communities, while his policy views contribute to debate on India's growth path.
